content.scenario: The State Government of Karnataka establishes a State Consumer Protection Council, which advises the State Government on the promotion and protection of consumer rights. The Council meets quarterly to discuss consumer-related issues and makes recommendations to the State Government.
content.outcome: The State Council has the authority to advise the State Government on consumer-related issues and make recommendations, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
